title: CARF / DAC8 Reportable Classifier
description: Classify CASPs, users, and transactions as reportable under OECD CARF and EU DAC8. Determines reporting-CASP status, reportable-user residency, and transaction-type triggers (exchanges, transfers to unhosted wallets, retail payments ≥ USD 50,000). CARF effective 1 Jan 2026 across 52 jurisdictions; DAC8 for FY2026, first reports 31 Jan 2027. Tier 1 Policy Mandate + Tier 2 classification CSV. Client-side. Zero PII.

user_residencies.description: Array of user residency codes to classify

mcp_tool_definition.name: carf_dac8_reportable_classifier
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classify a CASP and its users/transactions as reportable under OECD CARF and EU DAC8. Determines Reporting-CASP status per CARF §II; classifies user residency against the 52-jurisdiction CARF participating list (Jan 2026); classifies transactions by type (exchanges always reportable; retail payments ≥ USD 50,000; unhosted wallet transfers). CARF effective 1 Jan 2026; DAC8 (EU Directive 2023/2226) for FY2026. US implementing CARF exchange from 2027. Use synthetic data only.

entity_type.description: CASP entity type per CARF §II Reporting CASP definition

regime.description: Applicable regime: carf (non-EU jurisdictions), dac8 (EU member states), or both

user_residencies.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 residency codes for each user to classify

transactions.description: Transactions to classify; retail_payment threshold is USD 50,000 per CARF §II.D.3
